requirements.text: The system shall provide an introductory movie that can be skipped by the user via a mouse click.
The system shall provide a main menu with options to start the game, view help, or access the Denominators' web page.
The system shall present a series of multiple-choice fraction questions that form a storyline.
The system shall provide immediate feedback on whether a user's answer is correct or incorrect.
The system shall allow users to retry an incorrect answer.
The system shall adapt the storyline based on user performance at designated critical points.
The system shall calculate and display the user's final score and a customized message at the end of the game.
The system shall provide an administrative interface protected by a password to update game questions.
The system shall provide a Math Umbrella menu to link to other S2S mathematics projects.
The user interface shall be entirely mouse-driven, requiring no keyboard input.
The system shall be designed to be playable over a standard modem connection, with the main game being playable within a few minutes of initial loading.
The system shall be compatible with web browsers supporting JavaScript and Macromedia Flash 5.
The administrative question updater shall require a password for access.
The system shall be tested to ensure stability and correct functionality of the game sequence.
